definition: The perceptron is one of the simplest types of artificial neural networks and is a linear classifier that classifies data into two parts by a linear separator.
details: The perceptron is one of the simplest types of artificial neural networks and is a linear classifier that classifies data into two parts by a linear separator.

explainer.lead: The perceptron algorithm is one of the simplest neural networks: a linear classifier that splits data into two parts with a linear separator. It is a standard entry point for understanding how classifiers learn from data.

tiers.eli5: It draws a straight line through your data and puts everything on one side in one bucket and everything on the other side in another.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it as a baseline binary linear classifier trained to separate two classes; as one of the simplest artificial neural networks it is easy to implement but limited to what a linear separator can divide.
tiers.paperLevel: The perceptron is one of the simplest types of artificial neural networks and is a linear classifier that classifies data into two parts by a linear separator.

explainer.example: Given labelled points in two dimensions, the perceptron finds a line that puts the positive points on one side and the negative points on the other.
